answer: The vine escrow is released only against a dawn receipt, and the timber audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 146 aliases means carrying 275 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 40 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
